observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and campaign charter evidence index

outcome.implementation_change: The capability projection reads the bounded campaign charter pointer index, verifies candidate Git blobs by exact commit and SHA-256, requires the campaign-charter schema and matching campaign identity, and exposes a unique objective separately from session Work Intent. Missing, partial, ambiguous, or unverified charter context does not produce an objective.
outcome.analysis_limit: One campaign charter is verified and shown separately from the generic Work Intent. The change does not establish charter completeness in other campaigns or a change in agent outcomes.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket

improvement_relation.basis: Targeted tests verify unique charter selection, exact digest and campaign checks, ambiguity handling, partial status, compact response retention, and Work Intent separation. The canonical projection verified one user-directed charter while retaining the independent generic Work Intent.
not_measured: whether agents reconstruct campaign objectives less often
whether separate campaign and session objectives change agent outcomes
long-term effectiveness after subsequent development activity
cross-campaign recurrence of missing campaign objective context
agent outcomes or effort after this context improvement
